title: Selected official procedural and release timeline
subtitle: 21 selected milestones and 12 procedural relations; not a complete file inventory.
status: Source-qualified private research summary; no public posting or application integration authorized.

coverage.scope: Selected official milestones only, not a complete corpus or file inventory.

original_pass.html_reading: Selected text, not rendered-page visual review.

independent_source_review.scope: Distinct source review inspected the core assertions at their stated scope. Rechecking the same sources does not add independent corroborating evidence or another research round.

coverage.budget_qualification: The original pass opened one unnecessary catalog page for the same law and used official HTML instead of the planned PDF. The 13-resource and 12-HTML totals include that deviation; the original limits were not changed.
coverage.totals_policy: Collected, added, cumulative, redacted-or-withheld, House-origin page counts, media and headings are different or overlapping populations. No missing-page residual or unique-file total is established.

milestones.title: Federal investigation period
milestones.source_qualified_statement: DOJ’s later OPR statement describes the resolution of the 2006–2008 federal investigation.
milestones.qualification: Exact investigation endpoints, non-prosecution-agreement dates and state-plea dates are not established by this selected statement.

milestones.title: Arrest reported
milestones.source_qualified_statement: The July 8 SDNY announcement reports that Epstein was arrested on the preceding Saturday.
milestones.qualification: The source’s relative wording is retained; no exact arrest date is added.

milestones.title: Federal charges announced
milestones.source_qualified_statement: SDNY announced two federal charges against Epstein and the unsealing of an indictment.
milestones.qualification: Charges are allegations, not a conviction; the underlying indictment was not acquired for this selection.

milestones.title: Death in BOP custody
milestones.source_qualified_statement: The June 27, 2023 OIG announcement records Epstein’s death on August 10, 2019 while in Bureau of Prisons custody.
milestones.qualification: This uses a retrospective official statement. Detailed circumstances are excluded.

milestones.title: OPR summary release announced
milestones.source_qualified_statement: DOJ announced release of the executive summary of OPR’s investigation into the earlier federal case’s resolution.
milestones.qualification: The full OPR report and underlying agreement were not acquired.

milestones.title: OPR findings described
milestones.source_qualified_statement: DOJ reported that OPR found poor judgment by former U.S. Attorney Acosta and shortcomings in victim treatment, while finding no professional misconduct by Department attorneys.
milestones.qualification: This dates the public description, not when investigators reached the findings. An oversight finding is not a criminal conviction.

milestones.title: Maxwell verdict announced
milestones.source_qualified_statement: SDNY reported that a unanimous jury found Ghislaine Maxwell guilty.
milestones.qualification: This is the prosecutor’s announcement; the verdict form was not separately acquired.

source.title: SDNY Maxwell verdict statement
source.locator: Date and first sentence of the statement

milestones.title: Maxwell sentence announced
milestones.source_qualified_statement: SDNY reported a 240-month prison sentence and five years of supervised release imposed on Maxwell.
milestones.qualification: An imposed sentence does not establish time served or current custody. No monetary penalty is normalized or described as paid.

source.title: SDNY Maxwell sentencing announcement
source.locator: Opening paragraph and closing sentencing paragraph

milestones.title: OIG custody report announced
milestones.source_qualified_statement: OIG announced its BOP custody and supervision report, described serious staff failures and eight recommendations accepted by BOP, and reported no evidence contradicting the separate FBI conclusion concerning criminality connected to the death.
milestones.qualification: The announcement is the selected source. Agreement with recommendations is not implementation; the full report was not acquired.

source.title: OIG custody-report release announcement
source.locator: PDF page 1 opening; page 2 findings and recommendations

milestones.title: First-phase DOJ release announced
milestones.source_qualified_statement: DOJ announced a first phase of declassified files, describing many records as previously leaked before formal government publication.
milestones.qualification: This does not establish the first publication date of every underlying document. No released files were opened.

milestones.title: House records subpoena reported
milestones.source_qualified_statement: The House Committee’s September 2 announcement says its chair issued a records subpoena to DOJ on August 5.
milestones.qualification: The year follows the dated announcement’s context. The subpoena itself was not acquired.

milestones.title: House releases DOJ-origin pages
milestones.source_qualified_statement: The House Committee announced release of 33,295 pages provided by DOJ.
milestones.qualification: This is an announced page count, not an independently counted file total. The transfer date is unknown and overlap with DOJ releases is unresolved.

milestones.title: House releases additional estate pages
milestones.source_qualified_statement: The House Committee announced an additional 20,000 pages of documents received from Epstein’s estate.
milestones.qualification: Receipt date and file count are unknown. Official publication does not verify every enclosed statement.

milestones.title: Epstein Files Transparency Act enacted
milestones.source_qualified_statement: The official text records Public Law 119-38, approved November 19, 2025. Section 2(a) specifies publication of covered material within 30 days.
milestones.qualification: First publication or disclosure of the enacted text is unknown here. No statutory-compliance conclusion is made.

source.title: Official enacted Epstein Files Transparency Act
source.locator: Public Law 119-38 heading and approval date; section 2(a)

milestones.title: Thirty-day publication target
milestones.source_qualified_statement: Adding 30 calendar days to November 19 produces December 19, 2025 as the ordinary calendar target from section 2(a).
milestones.qualification: This is a derived target, not evidence that publication occurred or obligations were satisfied. First disclosure of the source is unknown.

source.title: Official enacted Epstein Files Transparency Act

milestones.title: DOJ announces additional production
milestones.source_qualified_statement: DOJ reported over 3 million additional pages and nearly 3.5 million cumulative pages, alongside more than 2,000 videos and 180,000 images.
milestones.qualification: All figures are source-attributed. They cannot be added as disjoint totals; none of the media were accessed.

milestones.title: DOJ production-process letter dated
milestones.source_qualified_statement: DOJ’s dated letter describes its review and production process, claims compliance, and describes exclusions and court requests awaiting decisions.
milestones.qualification: A process description is not an independent audit of completeness. The letter’s date alone does not establish first web publication.

source.title: DOJ production-process letter
source.locator: PDF page 1 date; pages 1–2 overview; pages 4–6 limitations

milestones.date: Occurrence date unknown; reported as of January 30, 2026
milestones.title: Pending release motions reported
milestones.source_qualified_statement: The DOJ letter says it filed requests for permission to release two categories of court-constrained material and would release them if permitted.
milestones.qualification: No exact filing date, entered order or later release outcome is established. A filed request is not a granted order.

source.title: DOJ production-process letter
source.locator: PDF page 5, Protective and Sealing Orders; continuation on page 6

milestones.title: Production announcement’s update label
milestones.source_qualified_statement: The current January 30 production-announcement page displays a February 1, 2026 update label.
milestones.qualification: January 30 dates the original announcement. First disclosure of the February 1 update and the particular content changed are unknown.

milestones.title: Library last-update label
milestones.source_qualified_statement: The current DOJ library page displays September 11, 2026 as its last-update date.
milestones.qualification: Original page date and first disclosure are unknown. This label does not date every upload, deletion or consolidation.

milestones.title: Consolidation notices observed
milestones.source_qualified_statement: Current DOJ notices say material from former Court Records, FOIA and prior-disclosure sections was consolidated here.
milestones.qualification: The notices support a section-level explanation for moved routes. They establish neither every-file preservation nor historical deletion.
